svg.title: Campaign to lead
svg.desc: A campaign_id set in Storyblok renders on the campaign page and its form. The form posts to /api/lead, which creates a HubSpot contact with the campaign_id, UTM parameters, and consent. On success the browser sends a Matomo campaign lead event named after the same campaign_id.
